subject: Re: Kickoff: MI-maximization study — pre-run status
body:
Hi both,

Status ahead of the June window:

- Chiara's standalone runner is done; a 5-run smoke batch at batch size 128 reproduces the precomputed Colab results within run-to-run noise. Dress rehearsal for the full 20-run protocol is scheduled 06-01, per Daniela's gate.
- Early signal from the smoke runs matches the study's headline: the estimator with the loosest MI bound is producing the best downstream linear-eval accuracy on two of three configs — another data point that tighter MI estimates don't buy better representations. This will lead the internal guide.
- Nikhil's retrieval extension: dual-encoder configs are written; recall@10 on the internal graph-retrieval benchmark is the extension's headline metric.

Risk: the runner's checkpoint restore adds ~9 min per run. Over the full matrix that's ~30 hours of the reserved week. Chiara has a fix in review; if it misses 06-01 we trim the architecture grid by one column.

Halima
